Block 73: the conserved translation-invariant operators of finite reach are a(k) + c(k) H; no scalar momentum of reach <= 1 is every species' own wave number; at reach <= 2 the only covariant one is (1/2) sin 2k_j (six second-order functions sin k_b sin k_c removed by the proper rotations); the part along the walk allowed is gamma sin k_j H, a second-order scalar. Block 74: the three responses under the maps: the frame's site stress Theta_a^j -> s_n D_a D_j Theta_a^j, the reach-two bond current J_a^j -> s_n D_j J_a^j, the reach-three bond current K_a^j -> s_n K_a^j; they agree at leading order for the first species, and K is every species' own stress: the frame serves species (000) and (111) and has the wrong sign in shear for the other six; reach two serves (000) only; reach three all eight. Block 75: on a closed lattice sum_z (Delta f)_z/f_z = sum_bonds (f_x - f_y)^2/(f_x f_y) for positive f; curvature member: never at rest on a closed lattice, whatever the signs of bodies at rest; simplest member (block 56): rest iff sum m > 0 > sum m w with the ledger exactly zero (both signs needed); a pair iff 1/|m_B| - 1/m_A = gamma (G_0 - G_d).
